candidate.answerReason: Because \(x\) and \(y\) are nonzero, dividing numerator and denominator by \(2xy\) is valid and gives \(2x/(3y)\). Hence \(k=3\).

methods.label: Cancel the common factor 2xy
methods.explanation: Divide both the numerator and denominator by the common factor \(2xy\): \(4x^2y/(2xy)=2x\) and \(6xy^2/(2xy)=3y\). Therefore, \(k=3\).
